programme.title: 影人映語 -大哥大唔易做 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: Sammo Hung, who was honoured with the 42th Hong Kong Film Awards Lifetime Achievement Award for his contribution to the film industry for over half a century, has been active both on and off screen. Switching roles among action-choreographer, director, actor and all over on set, he consistently produces acclaimed film from time to time. In this episode, the 'Big Big Brother' will talk about his multiple roles in the field and struggle story of Sammo Hung Stunt Team.

programme.title: 花心夢裏人
programme.desc: Fat Chiu and Frankie live together on a temporary basis. During their stay at home, they spend time with one of the home-mate Kwan and consequently build up very close relationship. Sally, who is Frankie's girlfriend, is deeply in romance with Frankie. However, when Pauline, a billionaire turns up, Frankie is crazily attracted by her. He decides to give up Sally. On the other hand, Fat Chiu immediately proceeds his plan and shows his care and love to Sally. Although Sally is so touched of the sincerity of Fat Chiu and accepts his offer, she knows she still loves Frankie. Kwan opines that Sally is damaging female dignity. Likewise, Kwan also disgraces Frankie as he sacrifices both his lover and friendship, simply because of his personal desire..

programme.title: 半斤八兩
programme.desc: Joseph Wong (Michael Hui), the kingpin of the Manix Private Detective Agency, a firm believer in tact and thrift. By tact, he means you can cheat all the people all the time and corners are there to be cut. By thrift, he means an underpaid staff is happy and grateful staff. By chance, he employs Lee Kwok Kit (Samuel Hui). Together, they have solved lots of wired cases. One day, while the two are investigating a blackmail case, the movie goes off and the lights come on. Scores of gun-toting hoods hold the more than 1,000 goers as hostages. On the stage Uncle Gaw (Shek Kin) threatens that it is a hold-up.

programme.title: 逃學英雄傳
programme.desc: Police Commandant Wong orders officer Ken to go under cover as a schools teacher. Ken's assignment: to stop the infiltration by Taiwan's underworld. Ken is chosen not on his merit. In fact, he is a coward by nature and a bungler of things by choice. But luck seems to be with him. Just handcuffs on Ball, the notorious Mad Killer. Ken's girl friend Hing has jilted him. Once in school, Ken falls madly in love with the sexy teacher Moon. The students, however, make fun of him. Among his tormentors, student leader Ace stands out. But Hing is also assigned to the school as an undercover student. Very soon, she commands the awe and obedience of all girl students. So, when she is told to locate and protect Doggie, the son of a Taiwan gang leader, she and the girls start to strip all boys off their pants to see if they have a certain birthmark on their behind. The reason: this is the only way to identify Doggie..

programme.title: 你OK，我OK
programme.desc: Twenty-five year old Liang Shao Chiang leads a boring life working as an auditor in a big finance corporation. He only has eyes for the receptionist Chow Yun-Lan. Chow is young and pretty, and is the natural target for the bunch of horny men around her. But she is pert and secretive, and no one is able to get even a date from her. Liang has fallen deeper and deeper for Chow. Alas this love is not reciprocative. But suddenly there is a breakthrough in his career, for four managers of the company is recommending a promotion for him! Of course, there is a price behind this - Liang has to let them use his bachelor apartment for conducting love affairs! Soon this scandal travels to the ears of the general manager Mr. Lui..

programme.title: 影人映語 -電影旦—鄭丹瑞
programme.desc: Lawrence Cheng has been working in the film industry over 40 years who was known with his friends in the 1980s as the creator of The Yuppie Fantasia franchise. In this episode, Cheng shares his motive of creation and key to success of such franchise, as well as how he got obsessed with film as teen. Looking back, he admits that he was not a very competent director and reveals more unforgettable stories of the past.

programme.title: 大鬧廣昌隆
programme.desc: An unusual story about an unusual love. Fang Yin comes from countryside to take over and run her father's hotel. She finds herself unable to cope. In distress, she turns to the first man ever to enter her life. It's a big mistake. One night, radio announcer Cheng Ming-pao is saved from drowning by the umbrella. He and she meet and confide in each other. It's Fang Yin's turn to tell Cheng Ming-pao she must leave him and that her ex-lover must pay the debt in kind..

programme.title: 小生夢驚魂
programme.desc: Miao and his good friend Halley are roommates. One day, they run into a robbery and get involved in a traffic accident. Halley suffers slight injuries but Miao is dead for all purposes except his brain wave is still active. However, when Halley cries over his 'corpse', Miao bursts into explosive life. Then, Miao takes part in a brain wave experiment that drastically changes his life...Meanwhile, Halley is targeted for revenge after identifying the robbers..

programme.title: 衰鬼撬牆腳
programme.desc: David died as a virgin and the Doomsday Book says a virgin ghost has no right for reincarnation until he deflowers a virgin human, so David assumes the human shape and goes after Lisa. Lisa's boyfriend Landal however finds out David is a ghost. He warns Lisa but she won't listen..

programme.title: 絕代雙驕
programme.desc: Master, The of Eva Palace enters the valley in search of 10 Untouchable Villians. Despite being married and having a child together, she and Yin fight each other without remorse.

programme.title: 通天大盜
programme.desc: An armored car of the Royal Hong Kong Jockey Club transporting several million dollars is robbed by professionals from different countries hired by Michelle. The police put Senior Inspector King to be in charge of the case and Lam, the representative from the insurance company also joins the investigation..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 福星高照
programme.desc: Two Hong-Kong cops are sent to Tokyo to catch an ex-cop who stole a large amount of money in diamonds. After one is captured by the Ninja-gang protecting the rogue cop, the other one gets his old Orphanage gang, dubbed the 'Five Lucky Stars', to help him. They don't like this much, but they do it..

programme.title: 光影穿梭機: 辣手回春
programme.desc: This is the first day of work for Yan at Sir Kau Kei Ho Charity Hospital's A&E. Yan is shocked to find that Jim, teaching her shedding job responsibility. An old man is taken to A&E after being struck by lightening. Each department dispatches him to one another but scrambling to take him after knowing that he is Ho Kau Kei. Ho wants to abolish the hospital's bureaucratic system, by appointing Yan, together with Joe and Jim to make changes by their own ways..

programme.title: 猛鬼差館
programme.desc: A Hong Kong police station used to be a clubhouse of the Japanese at the time of their occupation of the city during World War II. However, at the end of the war, many of the Japanese committed haka-kiri in the clubhouse. In the present time, after thief Sneaky Ming was captured and incarcerated at the station, he was lured into a world of the paranormal by the spirits of those still inhabiting the building. He was tricked into unleashing the fierce General Issei, who resurrects into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the city. As a result, police officers Kam Mark-K and Man-Chill attempt to put a stop to the terror.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Western Australia’s Murchison GeoRegion is well known for its’ ancient landscapes and\nbrilliant skies, this is the real outback. We take a journey through a region full of stories dating back to\nthe earth’s beginning, around 4½ billion years ago.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc:
Part One of a journey along the Kamilaroi Highway, from Willow Tree to Moree, in New
South Wales, taking in The Great Divide on our way to the Great Australian Outback. Magnificent
landscapes, awesome attractions, and we meet some really cool people as we make our way through
a region which traditional owners are spiritually connected to.

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第4集 -Vikings - River Trent
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette, take on the vast River Trent, following in the bloody footsteps of the Vikings as they invaded 9th century Britain. In the first ever archaeological river search of key Viking sites, they’ll be hunting for relics of Chief Ivar The Boneless and the Great Heathen Army as they conquered the Anglo-Saxon Kings of England.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1季
programme.desc: Bio-piracy threatens the most precious resource: Food. But scientists and farmers band together to protect the local plants and seeds. See how exporting agriculture threatens the economy and survival of the indigenous people.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1季
programme.desc: While the Malibu fires rage towards Darin’s home, he and Zac are deep in the jungle and off the grid uncovering the mysteries of the most powerful and potent plants in the Amazon Rainforest.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled 第1季第1集 -Northern Territory: Darwin - Vibrant Gateway to the Outback
programme.desc: Sara travels to Darwin, visiting markets and experiencing the local culture and delicacies, discovering strong influences from Asia.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled 第1季
programme.sub-title: Northern Territory: Connecting With the Country
programme.desc: Sara goes to Kakadu in the Northern Territory to learn about the Indigenous traditions of the area, including the wild herbs they use in their cooking.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Leysath rejoins his Indiana pal, Cal Ditmar, a professional trapper. During his last visit, Leysath dared Ditmar to cook a skunk. Yes, a skunk. Not to back down from a challenge, Cal shows how it's done. They also take to the woods at night in search of coyotes and other night stalkers and talk to some seasoned trappers to learn more about why they do what they do. Not for the faint of heart or weak of stomach.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Scott Leysath takes a look back at the first 5 seasons of Dead Meat and features 'The Good, the Bad, and the Slimy.' The journey has been full of surprises, but they weren't all good.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Don't Drive Here 第2季
programme.desc: If the altitude doesn't get you, the traffic will! That's what Andrew Younghusband learns in the exotic South American city of La Paz, where rules of the road are optional and definitely quirky.

programme.title: Spiky Gold Hunters 第1季
programme.desc: In the season finale of Spiky Gold Hunters, Dwayne is out to fill a massive order of urchins. And there’s a bigger boat and a larger crew called in for the task at hand. However technical problems, freezing temperatures and the power of the southern ocean puts the whole operation in jeopardy.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1季
programme.desc: Zac and Darin take a wild ride through a once toxic city and see how Brits are turning around their pollution problem with innovative ideas like living walls, urban bees and clean eating.

programme.title: Down to Earth with Zac Efron 第1季
programme.desc: The City of Lights sparkles even brighter as Zac and Darin take in Earth’s most important resource: water. Meanwhile, a town filled with unexplained miracle cures offers the ailing a chance to heal.

programme.title: Danger Decoded 第1季

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: Dead Meat 第6季
programme.desc: Scott hits the waters of California in search of the ducks...and duck waters less hunted. Join the surf scoter hunt on the San Francisco Bay, then head south to an area Scott Leysath refers to as ''The Hills Have Eyes.'' The Salton Sea, just a couple hours east of Los Angeles, has a creep factor of 11, and the duck hunting is like no other place he has hunted.

programme.desc: Dead Meat 2022.

programme.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled 第1季第4集 -Western Australia: Broome - The Pearl of Western Australia
programme.desc: Sara explores Yellow Water in Kakadu National Park. She learns about the different birds that visit Yellow Water and prepares an Australian-Asian fusion feast.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Part Two of our Kamilaroi Highway road-trip starts in Lightning Ridge and wraps up in\nBourke, and we’re blessed with more sensational countryside, and the awesome stories that make\nthis area of Australia so popular. This is a part of Australia everyone needs to discover.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Flanked by three Australian States this journey re-traces part of the expedition undertaken\nby European Explorer Charles Sturt in the 1840’s, when he was looking to discover an inland sea, in\nthe very interior of the country.

programme.title: River Hunters 第1季第5集 -Hadrian’s Wall - Chesters Roman Fort and Carlisle
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette are heading to Britain’s most spectacular and best-preserved Roman frontier - Hadrian’s wall. They will scour the two rivers that flow along its path looking for lost evidence from the might of 2nd century Rome and the invaders’ brutal occupation of Britain.

非凡人物
programme.desc: 70年代末至80年代初，一群受過西方電影教育、從電視台累積實戰經驗的年輕導演，憑藉銳利的鏡頭語言與對在地社會現實的關懷，掀起了一場徹底改變香港電影命脈的「香港電影新浪潮」。勇於嘗試、力求創新、無懼低成本仍然堅持自我風格，本集請來新浪潮電影始祖章國明導演暢談這股新浪潮精神。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 馮榕榕(策展人). 黃梓勇(大學講師). 嘉賓主持：. 章國明(導演). . #電影#導演#編劇#新浪潮#影視#章國明.

programme.title: 亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽2026
programme.desc: 第23屆「全港大專生機械人大賽」（Robocon HK），迎來九間大專院校、合共十五支隊伍同場競技。距離比賽不足兩星期，各隊形勢未見明朗。. . 香港教育大學第七年參賽，今年有前任香港大學隊員Henry轉投成為導師；闊別一年再戰的嶺南大學，則由歷任隊長Anthony帶隊。兩校亦敵亦友，都沒有工程學院，資源有限，靠「用愛發電」最終能夠走得多遠？. 另一邊廂，首屈一指的香港大學和香港中文大學各有風波。港大「明德」進度落後；中大「巧奪天工」遲遲未穩。兩隊作為冠軍大熱，在時間緊逼下如何能穩住陣腳.

programme.title: 太陽小記者- 2026西域記
programme.sub-title: 開發新疆 融入國家發展
programme.desc: 新疆得到國家的大力支持，在政治、經濟、文化等各方面高質量發展，積極融入國家發展大局。遼闊無垠的新疆大地，陽光和風沙孕育出獨特而豐盛的生命力。雪水滋養綠洲，成就了一片片生機盎然的農田。從先輩們披荊斬棘、開墾荒原，新疆用汗水與智慧，寫出一段跨越時代的耕耘故事。太陽使者親身來到這片大土，品嚐蟠桃、到訪棉田、葡萄園，用五感去體驗這片土地帶來的溫度。主持人阮頌陽再次重遊舊地，跟一班太陽使者到達石河子大學觀賞林則徐電影，在同一片土地上感受林則徐的堅毅與愛國精神。. 主持：阮頌陽嚴崇天. *************************************************************************. 太陽計劃2026由香港電台、香港中華文化發展聯合會主辦，保華基金會贊助，並獲民青局青年內地交流資助計劃資助。（本宣傳品僅代表主辦機構之立場.

programme.title: 傳媒初體驗 第三季
programme.sub-title: 第六集｜終極四強開戰！星級試鍊登場｜學生真人SHOW｜學界傳媒
programme.desc: 終極四強開戰，兩位星級嘉賓驚喜加盟，再度點燃起同學們的戰意！然而，這場「香港美食宣傳片」創作絕非想像中順利──有隊伍主創臨陣缺席陷入孤軍作戰、亦有隊伍深陷無限NG的絕望輪迴，要對付來回地獄又折返人間的星級試鍊，同學們能否守得住初心，及時化解纏身厄運？. 想睇更多：https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt31/programme/mediaeds3. 逢星期二｜晚上九點半｜港台電視31. 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目： https://rthk.hk/otg. 記得LIKE + 訂閱 + 推播通知. #傳媒初體驗 #傳媒 #校園真人SHOW #港台實習.

programme.title: 香港故事 ---近水留情
programme.desc: The 400-year-old Shui Hau Village is so inseparable with water that “Shui Hau” means “the outlet of a river”. Nestled between mountains and rivers, Shui Hau Village is surrounded by hills, mudflats and wetland. Villagers used to make a living by farming until the 1970s, when many of them were dragged away from agriculture by the urbanisation of Hong Kong, and since then the farmland gradually became wetland. The wetland has been abandoned for years, but re-cultivation has been carried out in recent years to conserve the topography and biodiversity of Shui Hau. Although the group of young people do not have much experience in farming, driven by their passion for conservation, they reclaim the farmland manually from ground zero in hopes of creating a sustainable environment. The villagers are delighted with the changes, as most of them were born and raised here, feeling deeply connected with the Village. Some of them have moved to the city, but they still have fond memories on the village life, so they return and actively promote ecological and cultural activities for the Village, hoping to raise public awareness of the historical value of the Village.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 周遊列車- 再出發
programme.sub-title: 周遊列車 再出發 - 烏拉圭
programme.desc: 南美小國烏拉圭，位處巴西和阿根廷兩個大國之間，擁有輝煌鐵路歷史。如今烏拉圭只餘下一班色彩繽紛的客運列車，往返利維拉與塔誇倫博，深受彭巴草原居民的喜愛。菲臘和南美牛仔高卓人見面，他們精通馬術，也在農田耕作。他吃過地道的美味燒烤「阿薩多」後前往派桑杜，那裡有一輛以1929 年福特老爺車改造而成的火車頭，是給員工使用的鐵道巡檢車。菲臘又前去大西洋沿岸及烏拉圭首都蒙特維多，那裡有一列火車，一年內只為一群鐵路發燒友行駛幾次。 Wedged between its two big neighbours, Brazil and Argentina, Uruguay is a small South American country with a great railway history. But it now has just one passenger train, which runs from Rivera to Tacuarembó. It's a colourful train, much loved by the inhabitants of the pampas. This journey takes Philippe to the gauchos, the South American cowboys who practice rodeo and work in the fields. After a good 'asado', the local barbecue, the railway globetrotter heads for Paysandú, where an old 1929 Ford car has been adapted into a train, a sort of draisine for the employees. Then it's on to the Atlantic coast and its capital, Montevideo, where, for a few days each year, a train runs purely for the pleasure of a group of railway enthusiasts.

programme.title: 非凡人物
programme.desc: 70年代末至80年代初，一群受過西方電影教育、從電視台累積實戰經驗的年輕導演，憑藉銳利的鏡頭語言與對在地社會現實的關懷，掀起了一場徹底改變香港電影命脈的「香港電影新浪潮」。勇於嘗試、力求創新、無懼低成本仍然堅持自我風格，本集請來新浪潮電影始祖章國明導演暢談這股新浪潮精神。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 馮榕榕(策展人). 黃梓勇(大學講師). 嘉賓主持：. 章國明(導演). . #電影#導演#編劇#新浪潮#影視#章國明.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 四隻海鸚發現利奧和貝莎擁有一隻海鸚蛋。由於擔心這兩隻水獺會想吃掉那隻蛋，牠們決定偷走海鸚蛋並帶到神秘的尊尼那裏，尋求幫助。海鸚們能成功救回這顆蛋嗎.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 在玩瓶子旋轉遊戲時，佩佩因為太害羞而拒絕親德仔的臉頰。看到這一幕，尊尼決定為四隻海鸚講述《白雪海鸚》的故事。這會改變一切嗎.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 本集中的速度動物寶寶目前尚未達到最高速度，但牠們具備成為地球上最快生物的潛能。小馬駒能夠疾速奔馳，獵豹BB將達到時速約120公里，遊隼雛鳥更將成長為全球最快的鳥類。本集呈現這些非凡動物BB及其對極致速度的天賦需求.

programme.title: 追夢者
programme.sub-title: Dr. Pui-wah Choi: The Science of Happiness
programme.desc: "I found my own path to happiness through science. How about you? You too can find your own path, your own way to make a difference in the world.". - Dr. Pui-wah Choi. Dr. Choi, a holder of a PhD from the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) and the founder of a Biotech company, is an accomplished female biomedical scientist with a profound interest in addressing women's diseases. Her doctoral research primarily focused on ovarian cyst formation and the migration of ovarian cancer cells. She pursued postdoctoral training at Harvard Medical School in Boston, MA. This included the discovery of new biomarkers for diagnosing and prognosing ovarian cancer. . Through her groundbreaking work, she has made significant contributions to the field by inventing a non-invasive kit that combines a sanitary pad for self-testing for cervical cancer. The journey of scientific invention bears a striking resemblance to that of Monk Tong, who obtained the sutra. Along the path to the east, obstacles abound. As a female scientist, Dr. Choi will share her personal experience and insights on overcoming challenges while striving to enhance human health and well-being. Her ultimate goal is to fulfill the dreams of others, enabling them to lead healthy and happy lives.

programme.title: 鄉郊豐年節2026：香港山水 · 聲舞 一日音樂節
programme.sub-title: 客家音聊 & 港茶/武俠情·空心樹
programme.desc: 本集聚焦嶺南鄉郊文化與經典武俠情懷，於荔枝窩展開一場跨越世代與地域的聲音對話。節目分為兩部分：第一部分「客家音聊&港茶」，由百歲客家村民黃強英與音樂大師譚盾展開跨世代對談，並在青年演奏家張夢的笙與劉雯雯的嗩吶合奏下，清唱《十月懷胎》等多首傳統山歌，古樸嗓音與現代樂器碰撞出獨特的文化韻味；第二部分「武俠情·空心樹」則移師荔枝窩百年空心樹下，由深港澳三重奏傾力演奏譚盾為經典電影《夜宴》、《臥虎藏龍》、《英雄》及《復活》創作的配樂奏鳴曲，讓熾熱的武俠情懷在古樹山水之間獲得現代新生。. 音樂節片段由環境及生態局鄉郊保育辦公室攝製及提供。. 曲目. 第一部分：客家音聊&港茶. 客家山歌（多首）：黃強英. 笙：張夢. 嗩吶：劉雯雯. 第二部分：武俠情·空心樹. . 《夜宴》鋼琴奏鳴曲：黃蔚然. 《臥虎藏龍》大提琴與鋼琴奏鳴曲：聶佳鵬、黃蔚然 . 《英雄》小提琴與鋼琴奏鳴曲：王倩兒、黃蔚然. 《復活》小提琴、大提琴、鋼琴三重奏鳴曲：王倩兒、聶佳鵬、黃蔚然.

programme.title: 香港同胞慶祝中華人民共和國成立七十七周年文藝晚會
夢想中華人物誌 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 李兆基博士憑著非凡的智慧與商業眼光，成功創立以地產為核心的企業。李博士以「聚散之道」管理財富，秉持「搵錢要成功，使錢要成功」的理念，致力回饋社會與國家：興建醫院、捐助學校、設立獎學金，為市民與青年提供機會；同時，他亦放眼神州，透過培華教育基金，長年為國家培育專業人才，影響遍及中華大地，他的付出化成希望，並以生生不息的傳承精神延續下去。. 受訪者包括：. 李敬恩（李兆基外孫女）. 李徐子淇（李兆基媳婦）. 李業廣（前香港公開大學校董會主席、港交所前任主席）. 王䓪鳴（香港青年協會高級顧問）. 李繼堯（仁安醫院院長及醫務總監）. 胡經昌（香港培華教育基金會常務委員會委員及公關組主任）. 李鴻斌（「牛津大學李兆基獎學金」得主.

programme.title: 國寶時刻 – 精裝版
programme.sub-title: 第十二集 金碧璀璨・映照盛唐
programme.desc: 唐代是中華文明光輝燦爛的盛世，絲綢之路的繁榮讓中原得以吸收西域、中亞乃至西亞的文明精粹，成就了金碧璀璨的物質文化。本集三件文物——北齊白釉綠彩三系罐、唐代八曲葵花形螺鈿銅鏡、唐代鑲金獸首瑪瑙杯——正是盛唐氣象的最佳見證。白釉綠彩三系罐的工藝與美學直接影響唐三彩，預告一個開放繁榮時代的來臨；螺鈿銅鏡將貝殼鑲嵌工藝應用於銅器之上，是唐代工藝巔峰的代表，更影響日本正倉院的頂級收藏；鑲金獸首瑪瑙杯的器型可追溯至四千年前愛琴海地區的角形酒杯Rhyton，橫跨歐亞大陸，見證絲路東西文明的深度交融.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.sub-title: It turns out I have ADHD
programme.desc: Childhood hyperactivity—often described colloquially as “big‑headed shrimp, never stopping”—is very common. When these behaviors persist into adulthood, there is a chance of having ADHD (Attention‑Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder). A university estimate suggests that 2.5 % of Hong Kong’s adult population may have the condition, yet data from the Hospital Authority show that fewer than 4,000 adults have been diagnosed and are receiving treatment. How can one determine whether they have ADHD? Is this behavioral disorder hereditary? In this episode we will invite adult ADHD patients to share their experiences, and the medical team will explain the latest diagnostic and treatment approaches.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.sub-title: 關節裡的「玻璃針」：拆解痛風的真相
programme.desc: ​「醫生，我隻腳好痛！」. 「我唔喝酒、又唔食海鮮，點解痛風仲會發作？」. ​​痛風，曾被稱為大魚大肉者的「帝王病」，如今已走向大眾。當體內尿酸過高，結晶便會悄悄沉積於關節，引發突發性的劇烈紅腫與撕裂痛楚。現時全港約有 3%的人口深受痛風困擾；​痛風絕非單純的關節痛，若延誤診治，不僅會造成關節永久變形破壞，更常伴隨高血壓、高血脂及肥胖等代謝疾病。痛風雖無法根治，但絕對可以精準控制！本集節目將帶大家拆解痛風成因及預防方法，助您擺脫痛風折磨，重拾無痛人生。. 主持：董光達醫生、梁凱寧. 嘉賓：東區尤德夫人那打素醫院內科副部門主管李嘉麗醫生.

programme.title: 香港故事: 樂地生根
programme.desc: 二十年前，葉佳是隻身南下的上海「國援」，視香港為短暫的客場；二十年後，他在香港繼續享受足球，於香港落地生根，將客場變成主場。. 經歷過高低起跌，葉佳用汗水、用努力贏得尊重。如今他主場出擊，從球員變身教練，助攻下一代香港球員，踢出屬於他們的未來。. . #葉佳#大埔#和富社企女子足球隊#足球#女足.

programme.desc: 大媽把東霓裝方靖暉把柄的手機丟進了洗腳盆。東霓下樓說她再也不會認大媽了。南音幫大媽說話，東霓逼問南音，南音承認文件是她拿的。東霓氣的要打她。西決忍不住說出東霓早就拿了方靖暉婚內財產的一半，可東霓還是不滿足。東霓故意嘲笑西決，江薏早就定了要去北京.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 巴黎，不僅是夢之都，更是一面映照東方想像的鏡子。今集將與您一同穿越時空，從中世紀城市規劃與中國都城的對比，到凡爾賽與紫禁城的權力對話；從周恩來等革命先驅在此點燃的理想火種，到貝聿銘用玻璃金字塔寫下的東西融合。我們將跟隨這道變換的「中國凝視」，從仰望到今日的平等對話，重新解讀這座永恆之城的故事。. 主持:. 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 陳芳芳(香港浸會大學歷史系助理教授). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授).

programme.title: 31看世界 - 科技保育
programme.desc: 第六次大滅絕迫在眉睫，全球科學家致力於保護受威脅物種。每天約有150個物種消失，保育工作面臨時間挑戰，因此日益依賴高科技。. 普朗克動物行為研究所提出建立動物互聯網，記錄動物遷徙並創建地球生物預警系統。. 在德國，人工智能能迅速識別紅鳶和禿鷹，並在危險範圍內停止風車運轉。. 在肯尼亞，人工智能快速統計濒危動物數量，發現長頸鹿數量大幅下降。. 在法國，已絕跡於地中海的扁鯊是否真的重現在科西嘉海域？. 高科技能否成為物種保育的關鍵呢.

programme.title: 亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽2026
programme.desc: 第23屆「全港大專生機械人大賽」（Robocon HK），迎來九間大專院校、合共十五支隊伍同場競技。距離比賽不足兩星期，各隊形勢未見明朗。. . 香港教育大學第七年參賽，今年有前任香港大學隊員Henry轉投成為導師；闊別一年再戰的嶺南大學，則由歷任隊長Anthony帶隊。兩校亦敵亦友，都沒有工程學院，資源有限，靠「用愛發電」最終能夠走得多遠？. 另一邊廂，首屈一指的香港大學和香港中文大學各有風波。港大「明德」進度落後；中大「巧奪天工」遲遲未穩。兩隊作為冠軍大熱，在時間緊逼下如何能穩住陣腳.

programme.title: 太陽小記者- 2026西域記
programme.sub-title: 開發新疆 融入國家發展
programme.desc: 新疆得到國家的大力支持，在政治、經濟、文化等各方面高質量發展，積極融入國家發展大局。遼闊無垠的新疆大地，陽光和風沙孕育出獨特而豐盛的生命力。雪水滋養綠洲，成就了一片片生機盎然的農田。從先輩們披荊斬棘、開墾荒原，新疆用汗水與智慧，寫出一段跨越時代的耕耘故事。太陽使者親身來到這片大土，品嚐蟠桃、到訪棉田、葡萄園，用五感去體驗這片土地帶來的溫度。主持人阮頌陽再次重遊舊地，跟一班太陽使者到達石河子大學觀賞林則徐電影，在同一片土地上感受林則徐的堅毅與愛國精神。. 主持：阮頌陽嚴崇天. *************************************************************************. 太陽計劃2026由香港電台、香港中華文化發展聯合會主辦，保華基金會贊助，並獲民青局青年內地交流資助計劃資助。（本宣傳品僅代表主辦機構之立場.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 如果要說對香港有重大貢獻的建築師，何弢絕對是其中一位業界尊敬的建築師典範。由香港文化區到東區走廊板道，都有他的足跡；就連代表香港人的區旗區徽設計亦都有份參與其中，可見何弢對香港發展的貢獻，遠遠不止於建築。. 今集《學人沙龍》將會帶觀眾認識這位香港建築師何弢的作品和理念！. 主持：. 潘浩倫(建築師). 董正綱(建築師). 黎雋維(英國註冊建築師). 郭美珩(香港綠色建築議會董事). #學人沙龍#黎雋維#何弢#西九文化區#區旗#區徽.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 人類足跡
programme.desc: 我們稱牠們為「人類最好的朋友」，但我們之間的長久關係遠不止友誼那麼簡單。人類已經將狗的祖先狼，變成令人眼花繚亂的品種，有花枝招展的亦有異於尋常的。正如我們在狗身上留下了「人類足跡」一樣，牠們也在我們身上以及我們共同生活的世界上留下了「爪印」。 在這一集尚恩的旅程從北極圈以北開始，在那裏因紐特雪橇犬的體力和耐力，讓傳統生活方式得以`蓬勃發展。但讓狗狗成為理想盟友的不僅是因為牠們的體力，還有牠們的智力。尚恩拜訪受訓中的服務犬和表演中的精英犬隻「舞者」，觀察狗如何以其他物種無法做到的方式理解我們，正是這種能力讓第一批狗在人類的庇護下茁壯成長。尚恩在墨西哥城看倒，數億隻狗仍然以一種獨特方式生活，一種既非野生，亦非寵物的方式。另一極端是威斯敏斯特狗展的純種競賽犬。透過研究經過數個世紀選擇性繁殖的純種狗基因，研究人員發現在某些癌症範疇，狗和人有相近的遺傳成因。 我們與狗是真正的合作伙伴，這種伙伴關係已醞釀數千年。狗的確了解我們，就像所有好朋友一樣，牠們教會我們一些我們無法單獨發現的事情。牠們在街上和我們的家中繁衍，數量比狼多出三千倍，因為在人類時代，成為狗好合理。。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月21日 星期一 晚上10時30分 We call them Man’s Best Friend. But there’s more to our ancient alliance than friendship. Humans have transformed dogs from their wolf ancestors into a dazzling array of breeds, from beautiful to bizarre. And just as we’ve left our Human Footprint on dogs, they’ve left their pawprint on us… and the world we both share. Shane’s journey begins above the Arctic Circle, where the power and endurance of Inuit sled dogs allow a traditional way of life to thrive. But it’s not just brawn that makes dogs ideal allies – it’s brains. Shane visits service dogs in training and elite canine “dancers” in performance to see how dogs understand us in a way no other species can – an ability that allowed the first dogs to flourish in humankind’s shadow. And as Shane sees in Mexico City, hundreds of millions of dogs still live this way – not wild, but not pets either. At the other extreme are the purebred competitors of the Westminster Dog Show. By studying their DNA after centuries of selective breeding, researchers are discovering the genetic causes of cancer… in dogs and in humans. Our relationship with dogs is a true collaboration, millennia in the making. Dogs really do know us – and like all great friends, they teach us things about ourselves that we wouldn’t discover any other way. They thrive on the streets and inside our homes, outnumbering wolves three thousand to one… because in the age of humans, there’s no wrong way to be a dog. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run)2025.04.21 MON 10:30pm.

programme.desc: 黃劍文(Kimman)年青時曾遊走世界不同地方演唱，亦參加過多個選秀節目，最深刻的體會，就是音樂療癒的能力。今集除了帶來新歌《默默》，Kimman還會娓娓道來音樂帶給他的力量。. 主持. 李志剛、周卓盈. 歌曲：. 《遠走》. 《默默.

programme.title: 國寶時刻 – 精裝版
programme.sub-title: 第十二集 金碧璀璨・映照盛唐
programme.desc: 唐代是中華文明光輝燦爛的盛世，絲綢之路的繁榮讓中原得以吸收西域、中亞乃至西亞的文明精粹，成就了金碧璀璨的物質文化。本集三件文物——北齊白釉綠彩三系罐、唐代八曲葵花形螺鈿銅鏡、唐代鑲金獸首瑪瑙杯——正是盛唐氣象的最佳見證。白釉綠彩三系罐的工藝與美學直接影響唐三彩，預告一個開放繁榮時代的來臨；螺鈿銅鏡將貝殼鑲嵌工藝應用於銅器之上，是唐代工藝巔峰的代表，更影響日本正倉院的頂級收藏；鑲金獸首瑪瑙杯的器型可追溯至四千年前愛琴海地區的角形酒杯Rhyton，橫跨歐亞大陸，見證絲路東西文明的深度交融.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 人類足跡
programme.desc: 我們稱牠們為「人類最好的朋友」，但我們之間的長久關係遠不止友誼那麼簡單。人類已經將狗的祖先狼，變成令人眼花繚亂的品種，有花枝招展的亦有異於尋常的。正如我們在狗身上留下了「人類足跡」一樣，牠們也在我們身上以及我們共同生活的世界上留下了「爪印」。 在這一集尚恩的旅程從北極圈以北開始，在那裏因紐特雪橇犬的體力和耐力，讓傳統生活方式得以`蓬勃發展。但讓狗狗成為理想盟友的不僅是因為牠們的體力，還有牠們的智力。尚恩拜訪受訓中的服務犬和表演中的精英犬隻「舞者」，觀察狗如何以其他物種無法做到的方式理解我們，正是這種能力讓第一批狗在人類的庇護下茁壯成長。尚恩在墨西哥城看倒，數億隻狗仍然以一種獨特方式生活，一種既非野生，亦非寵物的方式。另一極端是威斯敏斯特狗展的純種競賽犬。透過研究經過數個世紀選擇性繁殖的純種狗基因，研究人員發現在某些癌症範疇，狗和人有相近的遺傳成因。 我們與狗是真正的合作伙伴，這種伙伴關係已醞釀數千年。狗的確了解我們，就像所有好朋友一樣，牠們教會我們一些我們無法單獨發現的事情。牠們在街上和我們的家中繁衍，數量比狼多出三千倍，因為在人類時代，成為狗好合理。。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月21日 星期一 晚上10時30分 We call them Man’s Best Friend. But there’s more to our ancient alliance than friendship. Humans have transformed dogs from their wolf ancestors into a dazzling array of breeds, from beautiful to bizarre. And just as we’ve left our Human Footprint on dogs, they’ve left their pawprint on us… and the world we both share. Shane’s journey begins above the Arctic Circle, where the power and endurance of Inuit sled dogs allow a traditional way of life to thrive. But it’s not just brawn that makes dogs ideal allies – it’s brains. Shane visits service dogs in training and elite canine “dancers” in performance to see how dogs understand us in a way no other species can – an ability that allowed the first dogs to flourish in humankind’s shadow. And as Shane sees in Mexico City, hundreds of millions of dogs still live this way – not wild, but not pets either. At the other extreme are the purebred competitors of the Westminster Dog Show. By studying their DNA after centuries of selective breeding, researchers are discovering the genetic causes of cancer… in dogs and in humans. Our relationship with dogs is a true collaboration, millennia in the making. Dogs really do know us – and like all great friends, they teach us things about ourselves that we wouldn’t discover any other way. They thrive on the streets and inside our homes, outnumbering wolves three thousand to one… because in the age of humans, there’s no wrong way to be a dog. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run)2025.04.21 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 周遊列車- 再出發
programme.sub-title: 周遊列車 再出發 - 烏拉圭
programme.desc: 南美小國烏拉圭，位處巴西和阿根廷兩個大國之間，擁有輝煌鐵路歷史。如今烏拉圭只餘下一班色彩繽紛的客運列車，往返利維拉與塔誇倫博，深受彭巴草原居民的喜愛。菲臘和南美牛仔高卓人見面，他們精通馬術，也在農田耕作。他吃過地道的美味燒烤「阿薩多」後前往派桑杜，那裡有一輛以1929 年福特老爺車改造而成的火車頭，是給員工使用的鐵道巡檢車。菲臘又前去大西洋沿岸及烏拉圭首都蒙特維多，那裡有一列火車，一年內只為一群鐵路發燒友行駛幾次。 Wedged between its two big neighbours, Brazil and Argentina, Uruguay is a small South American country with a great railway history. But it now has just one passenger train, which runs from Rivera to Tacuarembó. It's a colourful train, much loved by the inhabitants of the pampas. This journey takes Philippe to the gauchos, the South American cowboys who practice rodeo and work in the fields. After a good 'asado', the local barbecue, the railway globetrotter heads for Paysandú, where an old 1929 Ford car has been adapted into a train, a sort of draisine for the employees. Then it's on to the Atlantic coast and its capital, Montevideo, where, for a few days each year, a train runs purely for the pleasure of a group of railway enthusiasts.

programme.desc: 東霓找到方靖暉，說自己不要錢，只要孩子。方靖暉表示奉陪到底。西決見到冷杉幫助東霓照顧雪碧，不置可否。東霓收回西決的鑰匙，交給了冷杉，讓西決以後不要再管雪碧。西決被問題學生昭昭打擊，前往北京探望江薏。西決和家人提出前往北京工作的想法.

programme.title: 非凡人物
programme.desc: 在充滿激情與爭拗的足球場上，若要保持絕對的冷靜與權威，究竟需要怎樣的一套人生哲學？本集嘉賓陳譚新，曾任職教師，亦曾投身警隊，後來更身披黑衣成為足球裁判，並踏上世界盃的最高殿堂，創下華人足球裁判的歷史。本集他將會細談在球場內外的故事。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 葉德平(大學講師). 嘉賓：. 陳譚新(前國際足球裁判). #足球#球證#世界盃#賽事#裁判.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 周遊列車- 再出發
programme.sub-title: 周遊列車 再出發 - 烏拉圭
programme.desc: 南美小國烏拉圭，位處巴西和阿根廷兩個大國之間，擁有輝煌鐵路歷史。如今烏拉圭只餘下一班色彩繽紛的客運列車，往返利維拉與塔誇倫博，深受彭巴草原居民的喜愛。菲臘和南美牛仔高卓人見面，他們精通馬術，也在農田耕作。他吃過地道的美味燒烤「阿薩多」後前往派桑杜，那裡有一輛以1929 年福特老爺車改造而成的火車頭，是給員工使用的鐵道巡檢車。菲臘又前去大西洋沿岸及烏拉圭首都蒙特維多，那裡有一列火車，一年內只為一群鐵路發燒友行駛幾次。 Wedged between its two big neighbours, Brazil and Argentina, Uruguay is a small South American country with a great railway history. But it now has just one passenger train, which runs from Rivera to Tacuarembó. It's a colourful train, much loved by the inhabitants of the pampas. This journey takes Philippe to the gauchos, the South American cowboys who practice rodeo and work in the fields. After a good 'asado', the local barbecue, the railway globetrotter heads for Paysandú, where an old 1929 Ford car has been adapted into a train, a sort of draisine for the employees. Then it's on to the Atlantic coast and its capital, Montevideo, where, for a few days each year, a train runs purely for the pleasure of a group of railway enthusiasts.

programme.desc: 今集講述有一位小鄰居覺得爸爸媽媽，甚至連婆婆都不疼愛她。因為媽媽不給零用錢，婆婆也不理她，感到失去原有的「福利」。到底「福利」是不是應該永遠不變呢？. 所以，貓頭鷹博士登場，引用《基本法》第一百四十五條，帶領芊穎重新思考。究竟這次是父母真的不再疼愛她，還是一場誤會？. 《基本法》第一百四十五條:. 香港特別行政區政府在原有社會福利制度的基礎上，根據經濟條件和社會需要，自行制定其發展、改進的政策。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
香港故事 ---近水留情
programme.sub-title: The Lam Tsuen River Keeps the Flow
programme.desc: The Lam Tsuen River originates from Tai Mo Shan with its watercourse stretching over 10 kilometres. It flows through Chai Kek, Tong Min Tsuen and the town centre of Tai Po, before it finally reaches Tolo Habour. It is a river weaving through both forested and urban areas, nurturing unique cultural landscapes. Chai Kek at the upstream is one of the few places in Hong Kong that retains the original landscape of natural rivers and streams. Ecologist Dr Ken SO leads urban dwellers into the riverbed to feel in person the temperature of the flowing water and its breath of life, and explore the biodiversity therein. She Shan Tsuen at the midstream is a Hakka village with a history of over 200 years. The trees in the Fung Shui wood on the hillside behind the village were planted by the ancestors of the village representative CHAN San-kwai. The trees not just block the wind and stabilise the land, but also have their own uses. One huge old camphor tree in the wood, which is even older than the village itself, has become the collective memory of villagers. Wallace is a ceramic artist deeply inspired by the Lam Tsuen River. He uses clay to record textures of the nature. He wanders into the Fung Shui wood and transforms the trees and clay into artworks carrying memories. The river continues its journey through the urban areas of Tai Po and reaches Tolo Harbour. The Coral Academy of the Chinese University of Hong Kong and the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department are now working together in remediation for the harbour to restore the beauty of this underwater garden where coral once flourished. Life needs to be nurtured, and so does the river. The Lam Tsuen River is not just a waterway, it is also a story intertwining human and the nature.

programme.title: 亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽2026
programme.desc: 距離本地賽尚餘一星期，各隊仍然忙於精修機械人。可是，仍有冠軍大熱未能完成門檻任務——組裝武器。究竟發生何事？. 來自九間院校的十五支隊伍，奮戰一年，終於走上擂台，爭奪代表中國香港出戰國際賽的兩席位。本集精選關鍵賽事，並由隊員親述幕後故事。. 只要認真一戰，人人都是自己心目中的「武林至尊」.

programme.title: 太陽小記者- 2026西域記
programme.desc: 新彊吸引之處在於其多元文化；從熱情奔放的民族風情，到巧奪天工的非遺手藝，非遺文化不只是博物館裏的展品，太陽使者透過親身體驗，感受活在當下的文化傳承。他們又到訪林則徐紀念館，凝視着一件件珍貴的歷史文物，深切感受林則徐的愛國情懷與浩然正氣。到了旅程最後一站–結業禮，大家懷著興奮的心情把成品展示，也帶著不捨的淚水互相祝福，旅程雖然結束了，但這份難離難捨的羈絆，已經深深烙印在他們的青春裏。《太陽計劃》留給大家的，不只是一趟旅程，而是日後點亮人生的珍貴片段，回憶那年盛夏的暑假，他們在新疆遇上了一段燦爛之旅，燦爛的不只是風景，是踏出去的勇氣。. 主持：阮頌陽嚴崇天. *************************************************************************. 太陽計劃2026由香港電台、香港中華文化發展聯合會主辦，保華基金會贊助，並獲民青局青年內地交流資助計劃資助。（本宣傳品僅代表主辦機構之立場.

programme.desc: 梁好逑(鄭裕玲飾)和連子蓉(葉童飾)為了改善生活，不約而同角逐香港小姐。選美前夕她們成為大小報紙的熱門話題，揭曉當晚她倆卻名落孫山。連子蓉被男友拋棄，為同病相憐的梁好逑所收留。次日，連子蓉返公司銷假時遭同事奚落，憤然辭職；梁好逑也因到電視臺試鏡被人譏笑。共同的遭遇使兩人成為好友。某日，一個自稱是日本華僑的青年(王敏德飾)闖入她們的圈子裡，成為她倆共同追逐的對象。在明爭暗鬥中兩人終於決裂。不久，青年突然離去，原來他竟是一個遊手好閒之輩；這對她倆猶如大夢初醒。最後，她們都找到了新工作.

programme.title: 香港故事: 樂地生根
programme.desc: 澳洲陶藝家Aby與汕頭妻子陳勤，因在香港修讀視覺藝術碩士而結緣，婚後在此誕下結晶。他們落戶南丫島模達灣，開墾小農田自給自足，更將島上的泥土化為創作原料，燒製成獨一無二的陶藝作品。香港這座文化交匯的城市，讓他們無需在語言上互相依附，能各自獨立生活、隨時出行看展。除了島上的隱世生活，他們更與散居香港各區的本地藝術家交心，建立起一個打破地域限制、互相支援的藝術圈子。這份自由與情誼，讓他們在都市與田園間，真正落地生根。. . #香港#家#陶藝#視覺藝術#藝術家#香港故事#港台電視31#香港電台.

programme.title: 國寶時刻 – 精裝版
programme.desc: 三件文物，三種瑞獸，見證民族圖騰的演變。銅牌飾獸面紋是中國最早龍形象之一；太陽神鳥金飾是古蜀文明標記；方形象紋金飾片融合中原與西域風格。由龍到鳥到異獸，三千年間瑞獸承載著民族的信仰與想像.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 鑲金獸首瑪瑙杯1970年出土於陝西西安何家村窖藏，屬唐代文物。杯體以罕見瑪瑙製成，呈獸首造型，形似橫放的牛角或平臥的羚羊，嘴部鑲金塞，紋理自然流暢。此杯造型與西亞、地中海的「來通」酒具極度相似，可能為中亞或西亞進貢之物，或由外來工匠於長安製作。它既是唐代宮廷的實用酒器，亦見證絲綢之路上的文明交流，反映唐朝開放包容、融匯多元文化的恢弘氣度.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 秦始皇陵將軍俑1974年出土於陝西臨潼，高1.96米，頭戴鶡冠，身披魚鱗鎧甲，昂首挺立，為秦軍區域指揮官，象徵秦帝國赫赫軍威。同地出土之百戲俑則上身赤裸，下身穿着短褲或者彩裙，姿態各異，生動展現秦代宮廷摔跤、樂舞等百戲表演。將軍俑與百戲俑一武一文，一面鐵血軍陣，一面樂舞歡暢，共同折射出秦朝不同側影，為研究秦代社會文化提供珍貴實物見證.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 鷺鳥紋彩色蠟染衣裙1987年出土於貴州平壩棺材洞，屬明代文物，由上衣與下裙構成，集拼布、蠟染、刺繡技藝於一身，是貴州現存最早的彩色蠟染刺繡實物。衣裙以藍、白、黃多彩交輝，突破傳統靛藍單色定式，飾有翔鷺、草木走獸等紋樣，蘊含苗族古人對自然的崇拜。此衣裙見證明代衛所屯田帶動的物資流通與技藝提升，體現民族文化交融的深厚內涵.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 七璜聯珠組玉佩出土於河南三門峽虢國墓地，屬西周晚期虢國國君「虢季」的陪葬品，全長約126厘米，由人龍合紋玉佩、18件玉管、103粒紅瑪瑙珠、7件玉璜、20件瑪瑙管、117粒瑪瑙珠及108粒釉砂珠等組成，結構精巧，繁而不亂。玉璜雕刻精細，龍紋蜿蜒，工藝精湛。玉佩不僅是身份象徵，更規範佩戴者儀態，體現西周禮樂文明對君子德行與行為的優雅詮釋，是先秦「禮樂相和」精神的生動寫照.

programme.title: 國寶時刻
programme.desc: 銅坐龍1965年出土於黑龍江阿城區，為金代文物，身長19.6厘米，重2.1千克，造型融合犬姿、鷹爪、馬鬃等特徵，並以卷草紋裝飾，體現女真民族「淳質尚儉」的審美傳統。坐龍紋人飾專屬帝王鑾駕，見證金朝遷都燕京的歷史。銅坐龍融合漁獵圖騰與中原皇權，反映女真文化與中原禮制的碰撞與交融。它是金源文化的標誌性器物，也是中華文明多元一體格局的生動見證.

programme.title: 看神州
programme.sub-title: 學者：中美元首八點成果共識為全球治理作出貢獻
programme.desc: 國家主席習近平早前完成國事訪美行程，與美國總統特朗普達成八點成果共識，雙方同意構建「基於尊重、公平、對等的中美建設性戰略穩定關係」。中文大學公共政策研究中心副主任孫晉認為，對雙邊關係和貢獻全球治理都非常重要。兩國元首又認可經貿磋商機制積極作用和雙方經貿團隊磋商成果，包括建立並推進貿易理事會等機制。孫晉表示，這是兩國十年來未有過的巨大成就。. 今年是中華人民共和國成立77周年，適逢國家「十五五」開局之年，天安門廣場巨型花籃選用了15種花卉和5種水果造型，連同長安街沿線布置的10組立體花壇，吸引市民遊客爭相打卡。. 電動單車在內地越來越普及，雖然國家已實施強制標準限制其車速和電池電壓，但仍有人非法破解限速設定，執法部門加強打擊。. 神州萬象介紹陝西興起的「菲林相」熱潮，以及四川成都高速公路設立「寵物驛站」.

programme.desc: 夾公仔機是「娛樂」還是「陷阱」? 夾公仔機、彈珠機店等近年在香港遍地開花，相關消費投訴升幅顯著，部分店舖更引入擲骰及抽獎等不同玩法。有法律界人士認為，骰仔已能推定為賭博工具，不只經營者，玩家都有機會要負上刑責。 目前這些娛樂場所並不符合《公眾娛樂場所條例》中「娛樂」的定義，難以監管。為此，政府計劃修例以釐清業界責任，到底規管方向是否對症下藥？ 有人當夾公仔是娛樂，但亦有人為此沉迷上癮，有玩家更承認夾公仔用盡積蓄。當娛樂變成陷阱，責任誰屬呢? 想睇更多: https://www.rthk.hk/tv/dtt31/programme/hkcc/ 逢星期四/ 晚上9時30 / 港台電視31 立即下載「香港電台隨身版(RTHK On The Go)」緊貼最新節目: https://rthk.hk/otg 記得LIKE + 訂閱 + 推播通知! #彈珠機店 #夾公仔機 #娛樂 #陷阱 #公眾娛樂場所條例 #有獎娛樂場所條例 #當夾公仔變成賭博 #玩家或要負刑責.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 -- 土耳其篇 (英文版)
programme.desc: Cappadocia is a must-visit spot for any traveller in Turkey, bursting with dreamlike scenery and a touch of romance. . Vicky and Meka finally fulfil their wish of riding in a hot air balloon, drifting through the sky to take in the magical landscape of Cappadocia’s “fairy chimneys”. Millions of years ago, volcanic eruptions buried this region in ash, and, over time, wind and erosion sculpted layers of canyons and caves. People cleverly carved fortresses into the rocks for defence, and built underground cities for safety—leaving behind the moving stories of Christians hiding to escape persecution. . The name “Cappadocia” comes from the Persian “Katpatuka”, meaning “the land of beautiful horses”. Embracing local traditions, Vicky and Meka ride gentle horses through the valleys, brushing past cave churches and ending their adventure on a dreamy note as the sun sets.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第六集 - 鄭衍峰、周卓盈、黃明德｜千年智慧九連環誰能拆解？
programme.desc: 本季最後一集有星級嘉賓藝人鄭衍峰、體育舞蹈員周卓盈Tracy和歌手黃明德Dark。三位對不同類別的中華文化都有所認識，漢代發明、唐代官制、經典文學、新疆基建、地理知識的問題，他們又能否逐一解答？想不到安徽黃山宏村馬頭牆的功能竟會難倒一眾嘉賓！而互動題為大家帶來由古代時興至今的益智玩具「九連環」，設計巧妙、又蘊藏數學原理，要拆解更加考起手腦配合！最後誰夠心靈手巧，再憑豐富知識，贏得最後一集的中華知識王令牌呢？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：鄭衍峰、周卓盈、黃明德. #中華知識王2#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#鄭衍峰#周卓盈#黃明德#安徽黃山#宏村馬頭牆#九連環#紅樓夢.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂 (英文版)
programme.desc: This episode takes audiences beyond traditional regional divides to uncover the authentic hometown flavors of Hanoi hidden right here in Hong Kong. . Owners Kenny and Julie pour their hearts into their cozy eatery. Every week, they personally air-freight fresh ingredients—and even hand-carry traditional Vietnamese decor back in their luggage—all to faithfully recreate the most authentic Northern Vietnamese dining experience, featuring specialties like Hanoi-style beef tenderloin pho and delicate rice paper rolls. . Though they rely on zero aggressive marketing campaigns, their dedication has inspired loyal regulars to spontaneously write articles and produce videos celebrating the restaurant, with local jewelry brands even reaching out for creative collaborations. Behind every steaming bowl of noodle soup lies the owners' unwavering commitment to authentic Vietnamese flavors—and the heartfelt, enduring bonds they have forged with their diners along the way.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 位於元朗工業區內，一間行業領先的大型洗衣公司與社福機構合作，將後勤工作轉化為殘疾人士發揮所長的機會。這項計劃不僅解決了人力需求、提升服務品質，更為員工帶來工作的尊嚴與成就感。. 其中，元老級員工豪哥自十七歲加入至今，從學員成長為工廠中備受信賴的骨幹。部門經理玉姐以耐心指導，協助殘疾員工在工作中學習與成長。洗衣公司深信，能獲得「Inclusive Buddy Award」有賴全體同事的支持與包容，正是這種文化讓豪哥與許多後勤員工找到自我價值。. 另一方面，香港科技產業中，軟件測試崗位重複性高且需技術知識，需反覆檢驗程式碼與介面。一間本地科技公司與社企合作，為自閉症譜系青年提供就業機會，發現他們的特質——高度專注與堅持——正是此崗位所需的優勢。當特質轉化為專業能力，職場的可能性遠超想象。. 兩間企業皆證明：敞開胸懷提供機會，所獲得的遠比預期更多.

programme.desc: "Lianli tree" are not really in love with each other, hermit crabs catch each other's shell. Butterflies climb the woodpecker to court, and egrets build their nests. Life seems to be avoiding that competition.

programme.title: 守藝薪傳：名家導讀
programme.desc: 本集守藝薪傳名家導賞版，麥勁生教授將介紹中國傳統文化中的長衫和手托木偶戲。. 長衫見證了中國服飾文化的變遷，從清朝到上世紀二十年代的上海風潮，香港的裁縫師傅逐漸發展出這一技藝。周師傅自十六歲起跟隨父親學習，三十四年來專注於長衫的精細製作。徒弟Katrina在學習過程中被這門技藝吸引，致力於研究和保育，並希望將長衫的美學融入日常生活中。. 手托木偶戲自光緒年間在香港扎根，曾是廟會的重要表演項目。「香港華山傳統木偶粵劇團」是最後一個手托木偶班，團主陳錦濤守護著這項藝術。年輕徒弟黃式瑜在厦村太平清醮活動中首次演出，見證了這門藝術的傳承與莊嚴.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到（英文版）
programme.desc: Hong Kong is one of the most wheelchair-friendly cities in Asia, with a modern public transport system and footpaths with kerb ramps. More and more shopping malls are also equipped with barrier-free facilities. However, there are still a lot of constraints for wheelchair users to get around. For example, where railways and buses cannot reach, they need to rely on wheelchair taxis and Rehabuses, but Rehabuses are very difficult to book. . In this episode, presenters Karan and Vita will experience the daily life of wheelchair users and their carers. Karan will follow Angel to experience a travel route on Hong Kong Island, while Vita will follow Keith to experience a daily route in Kowloon. What obstacles will they face? How difficult is it to dine out? How different is the actual time spent from the estimated time by general travellers? Why are some destinations unreachable? Why are the quartet so tired and out of breath.

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: Although locally produced fishery and agricultural products account for only a small proportion of total consumption, local products are still particularly appealing to many consumers. In the face of high production costs, a shortage of talent, land scarcity, and pressures for upgrading and transformation, how can the local fishery and agricultural sector overcome these challenges and continue to operate.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.desc: 本集將深入探索香港的蓮麻坑村，了解原居民對這個偏遠村莊的情感，以及村莊獨特的生活脈絡。蓮麻坑村的原居民對這片土地有著深厚的情感，這裡雖然偏遠，卻從未被荒廢。村內有居民生活了超過70年，許多人在市區工作後仍保留村莊的租屋，隨著年齡增長選擇回歸這個心中的家。. 村莊居住著劉、葉和官三個姓氏的族群，常住居民以葉姓為主。村民普遍認為，早期通車的公路及國際橋的建設使村莊能持續存在。儘管國際橋在疫情期間已封閉，但在過去數十年內為村民提供了便利的出入。透過蓮麻坑村的故事，本集希望展現香港少數村落的獨特文化與居民的堅持，讓觀眾更深入了解這片土地的歷史與情感聯繫.

programme.title: 亞洲TOP TEN 台灣篇
